name: ❄️ TDS: Battlefield
desc:
[ 🧪 Beta ]

Step into the role of a Tower in a world inspired by Tower Defense Simulator. Team up with other players to defend the battlefield against increasingly challenging waves of Zombies.

Please note that the game is currently in beta and may contain bugs or unfinished features. Any issues you encounter can be reported and are greatly appreciated, as they help improve the game more efficiently.

🛠️ New Towers can be unlocked by reaching the required player levels and by completing specific achievements.
